verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence shows Plaid offering versioning, review, or rollback of automations or configurations. The closest item is Dashboard Link customization with real-time preview and instant publish, which is a related feature rather than version history or rollback, so it earns no credit. Sandbox testing and webhooks also do not address versioning or rollback.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
